author: MeMyselfAndGhost
body:
IGN: MeMyselfAndGhost
Discord( Name#): MemeMyselfAndGhost#8344
Timezone: GMT +1
Any previous Ref experience? Was referee on OCN for like 2 or 3 tournaments.
Why would you like to join the referee team: I like spectating matches in general and see teams gameplay and stuff like that. I sometimes find it more fun that just playing.
Are you able to commit to Saturday Tournaments, and occasionally event staff meetings? Most likely yes I will be able to but the problem during this Christmas is that my aunt is coming and she will stay in my room and we're also moving pc to my room so I wont be active at all once shes staying here (Might be able tho, depends what day she will stay and how long, I would tell u if I'm able to ref or no).
A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself: I'm Ghost, I'm 18 years old, been here on avicus for the past 3 years, played like 2 or 3 tournaments. I'm active in game(I just play on alts) I'm also active on teamspeak. I'm pretty communicative person, also easy approachable. I'm also very memeful most of the time but once I need to be serious I will be. I dont know what else to say about me, I just said the most important things you need to know. If u wanna know more just dm me on discord I'll answer any question.
Anything else?: Not really sorry.
